notes: Apply the patches in 'order' to the STOCK media/Stripped/gamedbRC.slt (never to an already patched database) and write the result to mediapc/Stripped/gamedbRC.slt.
Everything under mediapc/ is copied 1:1 into the game's mediapc folder (abort if a file that is not ours already exists there).

mediapc/zipmanifest.xml and mediapc/Cars/AnimResourceConfig.txt are FULL replacements built from the stock files plus this pack's entries; when several packs/mods are installed they must be re-merged, not overwritten.

The pack touches no stock car slot and ships only its own engines. Slot conversions live in Z:/Forza/MyMods/Conversions, standalone engine swaps in Z:/Forza/MyMods/Engine Swaps; neither is part of the pack.
Rebuild after every game update (the database is a full replacement of the stock one).
One SQL file per car (user rule 2026-09-26): never split a car into stage/aero/suspension files.
Every car-local upgrade row (per-car / per-body / per-drivetrain tables) is priced 0 (user rule 2026-09-26); engine-family rows keep their prices; each car's sql carries the UPDATE section.
